proposals.before: The Three Dynasties could hand down sound policies on public finance, yet they could not keep later ages from the abuses those policies invite.
proposals.after: The Three Kings could hand down sound policies on public finance, yet they could not keep later ages from the abuses those policies invite.
proposals.reason: Chinese 三王 means the Three Kings, not the Three Dynasties (三代); the idiomatic rendering invents the wrong referent.

proposals.before: With the river frontier under alert and beacons firing, Jiqing Army Military Commissioner Handa said: "Bozhou once had sixty thousand households; since the southern withdrawal they could not bear the levies and fled—fewer than one in ten remain; below the Dang Mountains the countryside is deserted!"
proposals.after: With the river frontier under alert and beacons firing, Jiqing Army Military Commissioner Wendihanda said: "Bozhou once had sixty thousand households; since the southern withdrawal they could not bear the levies and fled—fewer than one in ten remain; below the Dang Mountains the countryside is deserted!"
proposals.reason: Chinese 溫蒂罕達 is the full personal name; idiomatic English truncates it to Handa, obscuring the surname.

proposals.before: In the eighth month of Mingchang's third year the emperor asked the Ministry of Revenue: "People do not store in good years and starve in bad—what policy will make them value grain and store more?"
proposals.after: In the eighth month of Mingchang's third year an edict to the Department of State Affairs said: "People do not store in good years and starve in bad—what policy will make them value grain and store more?"
proposals.reason: Chinese 敕尚書省 is an edict to the Department of State Affairs, not a question asked of the Ministry of Revenue (戶部).

proposals.before: In the eighth month of the third year of Mingchang, an edict to the Ministry of Revenue: "When the people are in abundant harvest they do not strive to store; at one encounter with famine they immediately face blocked hunger—what method can make the people value grain and store more?"
proposals.after: In the eighth month of the third year of Mingchang, an edict to the Department of State Affairs: "When the people are in abundant harvest they do not strive to store; at one encounter with famine they immediately face blocked hunger—what method can make the people value grain and store more?"
proposals.reason: 尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Revenue.

proposals.before: In Cheng'an's first year the ministry reported: "Reassessment was due in the ninth month that year, but could not be completed due to circumstances."
proposals.after: In Cheng'an's first year the Department of State Affairs reported: "Reassessment was due in the ninth month that year, but could not be completed due to circumstances."
proposals.reason: Chinese 尚書省奏 names the Department of State Affairs, not an unspecified ministry.

proposals.before: In the first year of Cheng'an, the Ministry of Revenue reported: "That year reassessment was due in the ninth month, but because of circumstances could not be completed."
proposals.after: In the first year of Cheng'an, the Department of State Affairs reported: "That year reassessment was due in the ninth month, but because of circumstances could not be completed."
proposals.reason: 尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Revenue.

proposals.before: In Taihe's intercalary twelfth month the emperor noted that reassessment crammed floating wealth, property, and prior rankings into a rushed deadline and ordered the Ministry of Revenue to adopt ongoing collection: from then on sales followed the trade, separate registers were kept, and only floating wealth was adjusted at census time.
proposals.after: In Taihe's intercalary twelfth month the emperor noted that reassessment crammed floating wealth, property, and prior rankings into a rushed deadline and ordered the Department of State Affairs to adopt ongoing collection: from then on sales followed the trade, separate registers were kept, and only floating wealth was adjusted at census time.
proposals.reason: Chinese 敕尚書省 addresses the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Revenue.

proposals.before: In the intercalary twelfth month of the second year of Taihe, the emperor said that during reassessment, since both floating wealth and property were questioned and prior rankings checked, the deadline pressed and affairs multiplied, hard to obtain truth—he ordered the Ministry of Revenue to fix a method of timely reassessment collection for household property: from now pawned or sold estates follow the trade in collection; separate registers set; at the time only floating wealth and property bound for increase or decrease.
proposals.after: In the intercalary twelfth month of the second year of Taihe, the emperor said that during reassessment, since both floating wealth and property were questioned and prior rankings checked, the deadline pressed and affairs multiplied, hard to obtain truth—he ordered the Department of State Affairs to fix a method of timely reassessment collection for household property: from now pawned or sold estates follow the trade in collection; separate registers set; at the time only floating wealth and property bound for increase or decrease.
proposals.reason: 尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Revenue.

proposals.before: In Taihe's twelfth month of the fourth year, officials serving afar often left family property improperly assessed; real estate sales were collected promptly, and families without floating wealth could petition ward and village assemblies for verified exemption.
proposals.after: In Taihe's twelfth month of the fourth year, the emperor said officials serving afar often left family property improperly assessed; real estate sales were collected promptly, and families without floating wealth could petition ward and village assemblies for verified exemption.
proposals.reason: Chinese begins 上以…, so the emperor is the explicit grammatical subject omitted in the idiomatic English.

s0225's reporter is 尚書省, the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Revenue.
